def top_k_by_score(items, k):
    """
    Return the k highest-scoring names from items, sorted by score descending
    and name ascending for ties. If k > len(items), return all names in that order.
    """
    sorted_items = sorted(items, key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]))
    return [name for name, _ in sorted_items[:k]]
